scope: Two HOB complete candidate definitions and exact graveyard cast-origin branching

cards.name: Plunder the Trollshaws
obligations: Draw exactly one from hand or exile
Draw exactly two from any graveyard casting permission
Flashback costs 3U and exiles after resolution
A copied spell was not cast and draws only one

cards.name: Moment of Glory
obligations: Only a controlled creature is a legal target
If cast from a graveyard every other controlled creature receives one counter
Hand/exile casts and uncast copies omit the other-creature bonus
Flashback costs 4W and exiles on resolution or all-targets-illegal fizzle
Returned same-slot target is a new incarnation and causes fizzle

shared_mechanics: Instruction::IfCastFromGraveyard tests the captured cast origin and rejects uncast copies
Instruction::PutOtherControlledCreatureCounters excludes exact selected target references and uses existing counter replacement processing

shared_contracts.owned_state: No new owned state; existing cast and target references, copy retarget state, counter replacements, and snapshots remain authoritative. contracts::owned_raw_index_and_restore_at_distinct_decision_roots covers unchanged ownership machinery.

author_validation.format: rustfmt --check passes for owned Rust files

review_status: Local author checks only; independent reviews and frozen integrated release validation remain for the final whole-set PR. No PR or merge was created for this cohort.
throughput: Two candidate complete cards in this recovered cohort. Recovery reused earlier author work, so no clean implementation interval is claimed. No simulation benchmark was run.
